recommended_brand_rationale: Most strawberry mentions in this sample are freeze-dried fruit snacks or fruit powders on Amazon Sports & Outdoors, plus at least one hydration-bottle SKU. That is not enough to assign MuscleBlaze (protein/performance), HK Vitals (wellness), or TrueBasics (premium functional) without further category validation.
why_it_works: Strawberry is the strongest opportunity in the analyzed dataset because it has the highest Opportunity Score among Decision Engine SELECTED flavors (91.45/100), the most eligible mentions (9), 88.9% positive sentiment, and a brand-fit score of 77.78/100. Based on the available consumer evidence, it is the best-supported flavor concept in this sample - not a guaranteed launch success.
